title: Futile Confidence in Egypt

questions.question: "Ah, stubborn children," declares the LORD, "who carry out a plan, but not mine, and who make an alliance, but not of my what?"
Who set out to go down to Egypt, without asking for my what?
Therefore shall the protection of Pharaoh turn to your shame, and the shelter in the shadow of Egypt to your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:3 (ESV): "and the shelter in the shadow of Egypt to your humiliation."

questions.question: For Egypt's help is worthless and empty; therefore I have called her "Rahab who sits what?"
For they are a rebellious people, lying children, children unwilling to hear the instruction of the what?
Who say to the seers, "Do not see," and to the prophets, "Do not prophesy to us what is right; speak to us smooth things, prophesy what?"
Therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach in a high wall, bulging out, and about to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:13 (ESV): "bulging out, and about to collapse,"

questions.question: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, "In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and in trust shall be your what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:15 (ESV): "in quietness and in trust shall be your strength."

questions.question: Therefore the LORD waits to be gracious to you, and therefore he exalts himself to show mercy to you. For the LORD is a God of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:18 (ESV): "For the LORD is a God of justice;"

questions.question: And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, "This is the way, walk in it," when you turn to the right or when you turn to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:21 (ESV): "or when you turn to the left."

questions.question: Then he will give rain for the seed with which you sow the ground, and bread, the produce of the ground, which will be rich and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:23 (ESV): "which will be rich and plenteous."

questions.question: Moreover, the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, as the light of how many days?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:26 (ESV): "as the light of seven days,"

questions.question: Behold, the name of the LORD comes from afar, burning with his anger, and in thick rising what?
And the LORD will cause his majestic voice to be heard and the descending blow of his arm to be seen, in furious anger and a flame of devouring what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:30 (ESV): "and a flame of devouring fire,"

questions.question: For the King is prepared of old; Topheth is ready... its pyre made deep and wide, with fire and wood in abundance; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of what, kindles it?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 30:33 (ESV): "like a stream of sulfur, kindles it."

key_verse_text: Therefore the LORD waits to be gracious to you, and therefore he exalts himself to show mercy to you. For the LORD is a God of justice; blessed are all those who wait for him.
